Wheel paint (inject on) is membership color. Inject off is gray of the same gate. Zero ignores that switch. Tazel and Vyrn in-band percents are densitometry. They stay a separate reading from the wheel color. Restore pigment uses pixels that still carry a faded signal. Author Aziel Eliab. This page stays on 127.0.0.1.
